# Historical source derivation

The separate `@evopilot-next/ontology/migration` subpath exports `inspectLegacySource(document, options)` and `deriveLegacyModel(document, options)`. Native v1 remains the only normative model contract. Historical wire identities remain historical; no six-field native reference is fabricated for them.

Both functions accept descriptor-safe finite JSON. Options are closed: `sourceLocator`, `sourceRevision`, and `sourceVisibility` (`public` or `private`) are required; `expectedDocumentDigest` is optional and rejects complete-document drift. Derivation additionally requires a new `id`, strict SemVer `version`, and `visibility`. Public to private is allowed; private to public is rejected. Visibility is a caller-supplied source boundary, never inferred from lifecycle labels. Callers must supply an accurate boundary.

Reports are deterministic, deeply frozen and typed. Invalid inputs return `BLOCKED` with errors. Unknown historical schema versions and Harness assets are blockers. The bundled strict AJV schemas and relevant owned immutable validators run before projection. Schema references resolve only within the bundled inventory. These functions read package-owned schemas lazily, never mutate files or input, and perform no network, active-state import, approval or publication.

Inspection returns the complete original JSON value, canonical JSON and canonical complete-document SHA-256, with declared schema/apiVersion/kind/id/version/digest and lifecycle observed separately. Missing identity fields are null. The canonical representation is not the original file's byte serialization; callers must retain original YAML/JSON bytes separately. `PENDING_PRODUCT_IMPORT` explicitly means preservation writes through product-owned M2 storage have not happened. Original semantics remain in the complete historical document; no old approval becomes new authority.

Projection recognizes the four professional Ontology Pack kinds, OntologyPack, Taxonomy domains/products, resolved Project Ontology Snapshot, Project Ontology Proposal resolvedPackSet and Artifact Set snapshot concepts. Technical records with no supported concept collection return `NO_MODEL_PROJECTION`. Identifier, supplied label and supplied definition mappings retain exact JSON pointers. Missing labels use the identifier with inferred provenance. Missing definitions use an explicitly unconfirmed placeholder, inferred provenance and a required concept-bound unresolved issue.

In-document parents produce directed native relations with the historical relationship meaning retained in the mapping report. Explicit relationships are supported only as `{id?, from, to, directed:true}` with existing concept endpoints. Other relationship shapes, missing endpoints, rules, shapes, imports and omitted core semantics produce required gaps. No missing entities are invented. Duplicate concept identifiers across Taxonomy axes are blocked as ambiguous. Meta-types, aliases, lexical hints and technical metadata remain source-only coverage, not equivalent v1 semantics. Required gaps prevent `buildDelivery`; the native validator itself is unchanged.

`coverage.mappings` binds exact source and target pointers and distinguishes `source-observed` from `inferred`. An inferred placeholder points at the originating concept, not a nonexistent definition field. `coverage.preserved` enumerates remaining source leaves (or empty containers) as original-only; `coverage.gaps` records required semantic loss. `fullSemanticRoundTrip` is always false. A structurally valid, buildable derivative is still not business confirmation: all top-level authority/businessConfirmed/released flags remain false.

This bounded bridge does not complete E03, M1, M2, service integration or acceptance. Import persistence, byte storage, business review and release decisions remain separate product work.
